summary: Small-town weekly page 18: CLASSIFIEDS in large flared small caps, black reverse category bars, sans liners with bold caps leads, and a crowd of boxed local-business display ads stacked along the edges with clip art, heavy borders and reverse blocks.

frame.masthead: Running head, then CLASSIFIEDS in big engraved-style small caps with an oversized C; black deadline box at right.

headers.notes: White bold serif title case on black, centred.

units.example: Garage Sale. Sat., Oct. 5, 7 a.m.-1 p.m. 204 Diamond Rd...
units.notes: Small sans body, bold caps lead, phone at end.

units.example: ROOFING AND ADDITIONS / DANNY C. MAY / 872-5930
units.notes: Edge columns are solid stacks of business-card displays: reverse heads, clip art (trucks, houses), big phone numbers.

units.example: Jon Clemons Real Estate / New Listing - 130 Wine Oak Dr...
units.notes: Realtor block with a run of underlined 'New Listing' entries.

type.look: Engraved-style flared small caps (Copperplate / Friz Quadrata-like)

notes: Business-card stacks along both edges framing the liners in the middle are a strong, reusable page shape.
